sources.snippet: The package includes the runtime code and configs/, but model assets are not bundled with the install. By default, scCAFM resolves model assets from the Hugging Face model repo kaichenxu/scCAFM through model_source. sources.snippet: Building a causality-aware single-cell RNA-seq foundation model via context-specific causal regulation modeling scCAFM is a single-cell Causality-Aware Foundation Model pretrained on 49.7 million human and mouse cells to infer cell-specific gene regulatory networks (csGRNs) and learn transferable, contextual gene and cell embeddings.
